scope: HOY Platform Core v1.0 across Gastro, Lifestyle and Works

claimRules.proven: May be used externally if the referenced evidence is included and still matches the circulated commit/release.
claimRules.partial: May be described only with the stated qualification; must not be promoted to an unqualified claim.
claimRules.open: Not an externally supportable claim yet.
claimRules.provenFalse: An explicitly prohibited or disproven claim; buyer materials must not imply it.

claims.claim: HOY has a versioned cross-vertical platform contract.
Missing, unknown, stale, disputed or externally unverified evidence cannot become confirmed truth under Platform Core.
A confirmed failed MUST cannot be rescued by PREFER.
Commercial placement cannot change organic score or rank.
Gastro consumes Platform Core through a domain adapter.
Lifestyle consumes the same Platform Core runtime through a locked vendor artifact and thin adapters.
claims.qualification: Evidence is repository-crossing and must be archived with the data-room snapshot.

claims.claim: Works consumes the same Platform Core runtime through a locked vendor artifact and thin adapter.
claims.qualification: Evidence is repository-crossing and must be archived with the data-room snapshot.

claims.claim: The documented central, Lifestyle and Works Platform Core runtime copies are identical at Git-blob level.
claims.qualification: Snapshot claim; must be refreshed when Platform Core version changes.

claims.claim: Platform Core materially reduces time and cost for every future vertical launch.
claims.qualification: Technical reuse is implemented, but actual launch-time/cost reduction requires observed expansion evidence.

claims.claim: The Platform Core implementation candidate passed Gastro Critical PR QA on implementation head 83996442d5686d07b454710df67fb13752732bef.
claims.qualification: Later documentation commits require normal final-head QA before merge/release.

claims.claim: Full Gastro browser QA is green for Platform Core.
claims.qualification: Workflow was still in progress at this snapshot. Refresh before external circulation.

claims.claim: Lifestyle Platform Core adoption passed critical/static/unit QA.
Lifestyle Platform Core adoption passed its defined Mobile WebKit and Chromium browser matrix.
Works Platform Core adapter is fully CI/browser certified.
claims.qualification: Static/unit/browser scripts exist, but no executable PR workflow is available on the adapter head.

claims.claim: Core technical product invariants are documented outside founder knowledge.
claims.qualification: This is technical transferability, not proof of fully founder-independent operations.

claims.claim: HOY can currently be operated fully without founder involvement.
claims.qualification: The technical handoff test is currently NOT_TESTED; full founder independence also requires delegated business/local operating proof.

claims.claim: HOY has a documented and machine-checkable technical handoff and founder-independence acceptance process.
claims.qualification: Existence and structure of the process are proven; successful non-founder execution remains open under TR-02.

claims.claim: Platform Core alone proves a durable market moat.
claims.qualification: Architecture is an execution/risk advantage; durable market moat requires external commercial evidence.

claims.claim: Shared semantics support more comparable cross-vertical and cross-region data.
claims.qualification: Architecture supports comparability; longitudinal multi-region scale is not yet proven.

claims.claim: HOY approves sale/export of row-level identifiable or pseudonymous user journeys as an intelligence product.
claims.qualification: Buyer materials must describe the preferred model as sufficiently aggregated, rights-cleared intelligence rather than user-level brokerage.

claims.claim: HOY already has a commercially proven hard-to-recreate longitudinal data moat at scale.
claims.qualification: Requires live, rights-cleared longitudinal data quality, multi-region scale and commercial proof.

claims.claim: Platform Core by itself increases HOY enterprise value by a fixed euro amount.
claims.qualification: Architecture should be treated as a risk/quality factor; realized valuation impact depends on buyer context and external proof.

allowedOnlyWhen: evidence still matches the circulated commit/release
OPEN claims are not presented as facts
legal/privacy/IP/market DD registers are reconciled separately
